# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/turbo998/data-lab/security/advisories/new) rather than opening a public issue with exploit details or sensitive evidence.

## Sensitive Data & Secret Hygiene

- Never commit `.env` files, API keys, bearer tokens, private keys, or live cloud credentials.
- Redact personal identifiers (emails, phone numbers, internal URLs, subscription/tenant IDs, and local workstation paths) before committing examples, logs, or benchmark evidence.
